text:
Jared: Quick pulse check 12: heading to SLU next Tue for offsite, anyone know a good spot near 9th Ave for dumplings/of-the-day plates? Prefer casual, good veggie options.
Maya: Din Tai Fung is a bit of a trek but perfect for dumplings. 15-20m walk.
Priya: There's a tiny spot called Steam & Fold on 8th that does killer veggie xiao long bao and has big communal tables.
Owen: Steam & Fold is great but tight seating. They do accept a small reservation for 6 if you call.
Sofia: If y'all want something walk-in friendly, BaoBros on Mercer has outdoor seating and solid vegan bao.
Jared: Vote emoji style: :one: Din Tai Fung  :two: Steam & Fold  :three: BaoBros
Maya: :two:
Priya: :two: :thumbsup:
Owen: :three: (outside sounds nice if weather holds)
Sofia: :three:
Jared: Weather looks clear. Leaning BaoBros for easy + outdoor. Maya, can you try calling Steam & Fold as backup?
Maya: On it. Calling now...
Maya: Steam & Fold can do Tue 6:30pm, party of 6, Conf S&F-778. They flagged that their gluten-free bao is limited but rice bowls are GF-friendly.
Jared: Great, we'll use Steam & Fold as primary then. Sofia, will you add to calendar and set a reminder?
Sofia: Done 12: added "Tue SLU: Steam & Fold 6:30pm" to #team-calendar.
calendar-bot: Event added to #team-calendar 2: "Steam & Fold - Offsite Dinner (6:30pm)"
Taco-bot: Reminder: street parking near 9th is limited after 6pm. Consider rideshare. :oncoming_taxi:
Jared: Thanks everyone! See you Tuesday 12:
